posts.title: Erode property market: what changed in 2026
posts.excerpt: Prices along the Perundurai Road and Thindal belt held steady this year, while plot enquiries around Vijayamangalam rose.
posts.body:
## The short version

Residential prices in the Thindal, Nasiyanur and Perundurai Road belt held steady through 2026. Demand for ready villas stayed healthy, and well-priced plots in approved layouts around Vijayamangalam and Ingur moved faster than last year.

## What buyers are asking for

- East-facing 3 BHK villas between ₹70 lakh and ₹1 crore
- DTCP or RERA-approved plots under ₹20 lakh
- Covered parking and reliable borewell water

## Rentals

Furnished 2 BHK flats near schools on Perundurai Road rent within two to three weeks when priced realistically. Industrial sheds near SIPCOT continue to see enquiries from textile and engineering units.

## Our advice

Price to the market from day one. Listings that start 10–15% above comparable homes usually sit for months and end up selling for less.

posts.title: A buyer's checklist before you pay an advance
posts.excerpt: Ten documents and checks to complete before you pay a token advance for a plot or house in Tamil Nadu.
posts.body:
## Before any advance

An advance creates obligations. Complete these checks first, with your lawyer:

- **Parent documents** for at least 30 years, and the latest sale deed
- **Encumbrance certificate** (EC) from the TNREGINET portal for the full period
- **Patta, chitta and adangal** matching the seller's name and survey number
- **Approval** – DTCP or local-body approved layout and building plan
- **Property tax and EB receipts** up to date

## On the site

Walk the boundaries with the survey sketch. Check road width, water source and drainage. Ask neighbours about any disputes.

## Costs to budget

Add stamp duty, registration fees, legal fees and our brokerage to the price. Use our [calculators](/tools) to estimate them.

posts.title: Renting out your home: how property management works
posts.excerpt: From finding a tenant to monthly statements, here is what our management service covers for owners.
posts.body:
## What we take care of

We advertise the property, screen tenants, arrange the rental agreement and handover, collect rent and coordinate repairs. Every month you receive a statement showing rent collected, our fee, any maintenance costs and the amount transferred to you.

## Owner funds are kept separate

Rent and deposits are held in a separate owner-funds account and are never counted as our income. Payouts are made by bank transfer and the reference is recorded on your statement.

## Owner portal

Owners can sign in to see rent status, statements, maintenance requests and documents at any time – useful if you live outside Erode or abroad.

posts.title: Industrial sheds near SIPCOT Perundurai: a quick guide
posts.excerpt: Power, access and lease terms to check when you lease a factory shed near SIPCOT.
posts.body:
## Power first

Confirm the sanctioned load in HP or kVA with the latest EB bill, and whether the transformer is shared.

## Access

Check road width for 40 ft containers, turning space and truck parking.

## Lease terms

Typical terms are 3–9 years with 5% escalation every year or 15% every three years, and a security deposit of 6–10 months' rent. Agree in writing who pays for repairs to the roof, flooring and electrical panels.
